# NeoBrutal Soft

NeoBrutal Soft is a Soft Neo-Brutalism design system for SaaS, admin, developer tools, agent workflows, licensing, commerce operations, and long-session product interfaces.

Primary design law: Compress, never float.

Canonical sources:
- Human overview: README.md
- Design language: DESIGN.md
- Agent instructions: LLMS.md
- Component matrix: COMPONENTS.md
- Quality gate: QUALITY.md
- Resilience contract: RESILIENCE.md
- Machine manifest: registry/manifest.json
- shadcn source registry: registry.json
- CSS entrypoint: src/index.css
- React wrappers: packages/react/src/index.js

Public behavioral references:
- Flagship: index.html
- Full interactive component explorer: components.html
- Current NeoLicenser application dogfood: demo/v07.html

Important generation rules:
- ordinary interactive controls compress into their shadow on hover/press; never add generic upward hover lift
- use semantic --nbs-* tokens and nbs-* component classes
- preserve light/dark parity, visible focus, keyboard access, touch access, reduced-motion meaning, RTL and forced-colors resilience
- charts explain operational questions and expose exact values
- agent changes should be inspectable and reviewable before sensitive execution
- preserve webhook failure history and partial-failure truth
- show timezone, absolute timing, billing, seat, and rollout consequences before commitment
- agents should operate on credential references rather than raw secrets
- use components.html and demo/v07.html as behavior references, not as permission to copy demo-specific cx-* or v07-* layout classes into reusable product components

Read LLMS.md before generating substantial NeoBrutal Soft UI.
